profile.positioning: Hassan Oduya is a seasoned technology executive and serial entrepreneur specializing in the application of artificial intelligence to optimize complex logistical systems. He seeks to connect with investors and industry leaders who share a commitment to ethical AI and a vision for the future of supply chain management.
